answer_1.quote: CoPA generates more diverse and humanlike sentences, which exhibit remarkable effectiveness in deceiving LLM-text detectors.

answer_2.quote: We report the true positive rate (TPR) at a fixed FPR... and semantic similarity using the P‑SP score (exceeding 0.76), as well as text perplexity.

answer_3.quote: We provide more analysis including text perplexity, GPT-4 assisted and human evaluation.
methods: GPT-4 assisted evaluation of paraphrased texts

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation results in Appendix H indicate that CoPA-paraphrased texts are preferred over those from Dipper.
